scenarios.trigger_event: Celery / FastStream Worker heartbeat missed for 45 seconds
scenarios.automated_resolution: Supervisor daemon terminates dead process, spawns fresh worker, and re-subscribes to message queue
Connection pool detects broken socket, initiates backoff reconnect, and drains pending buffer

scenarios.recovery_type: PostgreSQL Connection Pool Stale Connection Recycle
scenarios.trigger_event: Database server closed idle connection (FATAL: terminating connection due to idle timeout)
scenarios.automated_resolution: SQLAlchemy pool pre-ping detects invalid connection, discards stale socket, and checks out fresh connection

scenarios.trigger_event: Worker holds document processing lock but crashes before TTL expiry (Lock age > 300s)
scenarios.automated_resolution: Autonomous Lock Reaper identifies dead owner UUID, forces lock release, and generates audit log

scenarios.trigger_event: Document remains in PROCESSING state for > 600s with no active worker heartbeat
scenarios.automated_resolution: Orphan Task Engine transitions document back to PENDING with retry counter incremented
